pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-brown polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are smooth rather than sharp. Patches are larger and more elongated on the mid-flank, becoming smaller and more irregularly circular toward the dorsal and caudal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial network forming a continuous graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly on the lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper cervical region, the mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The individual hairs create a fine-textured fringe against the background.
